urgent.heading: Okuphuthumayo - shayela manje
urgent.primary_message: Shayela i-ambulensi ngokushesha. Qaphela isikhathi esiqondile izimpawu zaqala.
red_flags: Olunye uhlangothi lobuso obulengayo - bacele ukuthi bamamatheke
Ubuthakathaka bengalo ngakolunye uhlangothi — bacele ukuthi baphakamise izingalo zombili
Inkulumo engacacile noma engajwayelekile — bacele ukuthi baphinde umusho
Ikhanda elibuhlungu kungazelelwe ngaphandle kwesizathu esaziwayo
Ukulahlekelwa umbono kungazelelwe kwelinye noma womabili iso

what_is_it.heading: Stroke ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: I-stroke kwenzeka lapho ukugeleza kwegazi engxenyeni yobuchopho kunqamuka kungazelelwe. Amaseli obuchopho aqala ukufa emizuzwini embalwa.
paragraphs: Imivimbo eminingi iyenzeka lapho ihlule livimba imithambo yegazi ebuchosheni. Inani elincane lenzeka lapho umkhumbi uqhuma futhi igazi lingena ngaphakathi. Kokubili kuyizimo eziphuthumayo futhi kubukeka ngendlela efanayo ngaphandle - awukwazi ukubona ukuthi iyiphi ngaphandle kweskena sasesibhedlela.

Uma isifo sohlangothi selashwa ngokushesha, kulapho ubuchopho bungasinda khona. Imithi evala amahlule isebenza kahle kakhulu emahoreni ambalwa okuqala. Ngemva kwalokho, umonakalo uba unomphela. Yingakho imizuzu ibalulekile.

items.headline: Amaminithi abalulekile
items.body: Cishe amangqamuzana obuchopho ayizigidi ezingu-2 afa umzuzu ngamunye ngesikhathi sohlangothi. Iwashi liqala kuphawu lokuqala.
Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bahlaselwa isifo sohlangothi minyaka yonke. Yimbangela ehamba phambili yokukhubazeka nokufa kwabantu abadala.

items.headline: Kuyagwemeka
items.body: Imivimbo eminingi ixhumene nomfutho wegazi ophakeme, ukubhema, isifo sikashukela, nokudla - konke lokhu kungalawuleka.

items.headline: Ukululama kungenzeka
items.body: Ukusebenza ngehora lokuqala kunikeza ithuba elihle kakhulu lokululama ngokugcwele. Izibhedlela zinemithi yokwelapha ethatha isikhathi eside.

pull_quote.text: Uma usola isifo sohlangothi, ungalindi ukubona ukuthi kuhamba kanjani. Shayela ucingo i-ambulensi. Ngisho noma izimpawu zidlula ngokwazo - lokho ngokwakho kuwuphawu oluyisixwayiso.

signs.heading: Ukuhlolwa kwe-FAST
signs.lede: Izimpawu zokushaywa unhlangothi zivela ngokuzumayo. Lapho uzibona ngokushesha, kulapho ubuchopho bungasinda khona. Khumbula FAST.

items.title: F - Ubuso obude
items.description: Bacele bamamatheke. Ingabe uhlangothi olulodwa lomlomo noma lobuso luyashona, ngisho nangobuqili?

items.title: A - Ubuthakathaka bengalo
items.description: Bacele ukuthi baphakamise izingalo zombili. Ingabe umuntu ukhukhuleka aye phansi noma azizwe endikindiki? Bangakwazi ukubamba bobabili ngokulinganayo?

items.title: S - Ubunzima bokukhuluma
items.description: Bacele ukuthi baphinde umusho olula. Ingabe inkulumo yabo iphithene, iyinqaba, noma inzima ukuyiqonda?

items.title: T — Isikhathi sokufona
items.description: Uma ubona noma yiziphi zalezi zimpawu, shayela ku-10177 ngokushesha. Qaphela isikhathi esiqondile izimpawu zaqala.

items.myth: Ukushaywa unhlangothi kwenzeka kubantu abadala kuphela.
items.fact: Imivimbo ingenzeka kunoma ibuphi ubudala. Cishe i-stroke eyodwa kwezi-4 kwenzeka kubantu abangaphansi kweminyaka engama-65, futhi inani liyenyuka kwabancane abadala.

items.myth: Uma izimpawu zidlula ngokushesha, kwakungesona isifo sohlangothi sangempela.
items.fact: Isiqephu esifushane (i-TIA noma 'i-mini-stroke') siyisixwayiso esibucayi. Cishe umuntu oyedwa kwabangu-3 abane-TIA uzoba ne-stroke egcwele - abaningi phakathi namahora angu-48.

items.myth: Kufanele ngibayise esibhedlela ngokwami ​​- ngokushesha kunokulinda i-ambulensi.
items.fact: Abezimo eziphuthumayo baqala ukwelashwa nge-ambulensi kanye nomzila oya esibhedlela esifanele esikwazi ukushaywa unhlangothi. Ukuzishayela kumosha isikhathi esibucayi futhi kuyingozi.
Unganikezi i-aspirin ngesikhathi sohlangothi olusolekayo. Uma kuwuhlangothi olophayo (cishe isigameko esi-1 kwezingu-5), i-aspirin izokwenza kube kubi nakakhulu. Shayela i-ambulensi ulinde.

action_steps.heading: Okufanele ukwenze - lapho usola isifo sohlangothi

items.title: Shayela ku-10177 noma ku-112 ngokushesha
items.description: Isho ngokucacile igama elithi 'stroke'. Abezimo eziphuthumayo bazobeka phambili futhi baqonde esibhedlela esikwazi ukushaywa unhlangothi.

items.title: Qaphela isikhathi esiqondile izimpawu zaqala
items.description: Lokhu kunquma ukuthi yiziphi izindlela zokwelapha ezingenzeka. Ngisho nesikhathi esilinganiselwe kusiza ithimba lasesibhedlela.

items.title: Ungakuniki ukudla, amanzi, noma imithi
items.description: Umuntu angase abe nenkinga yokugwinya. Unganikezi lutho ngomlomo - kuhlanganise ne-aspirin.

items.title: Uma equlekile, walalise ngohlangothi
items.description: Indawo yokutakula igcina indlela yomoya icacile. Uma beqaphela, bagcine benethezekile futhi beqinisekisiwe.

items.title: Hlala nabo kuze kufike abezimo eziphuthumayo
items.description: Bheka ukuphefumula kwabo. Balungele ukwenza i-CPR uma beyeka ukuphefumula. Vula umnyango ukuze abezimo eziphuthumayo bakwazi ukungena.

get_help.heading: Ubani okumele ashayele khona manje
get_help.lede: I-stroke okusolwa ukuthi iyisimo esiphuthumayo. Shaya manje. Ungazishayeli noma ulinde ukuthi izimpawu zidlulele ngokwazo.

helplines.name: Isimo esiphuthumayo (iselula)
helplines.description: Ifinyelela kunoma iyiphi isevisi yezimo eziphuthumayo ngomakhalekhukhwini
helplines.meta: Kumahhala kunoma iyiphi iselula · amahora angama-24

helplines.name: I-Heart and Stroke Foundation SA
helplines.description: Ulwazi, ukusekelwa, kanye nokudluliselwa kokuvuselelwa ngemva kokushaywa unhlangothi
